mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVE WHERE STATUS = 'Y' AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_RESERVE WHERE STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT RESERVE_NO reserveNo , CAR_NO carNo , MEMBER_NO memberNo , RESERVE_DATE reserveDate , RENTAL_START_DATE rentalStartDate , RENTAL_END_DATE rentalEndDate , APPROVE_STATUS approveStatus FROM TB_RESERVE WHERE STATUS = 'Y' AND MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY RESERVE_DATE DESC

SELECT R.RESERVE_NO reserveNo , R.CAR_NO carNo , C.CAR_NAME carName , R.MEMBER_NO memberNo , M.MEMBER_NAME memberName , M.MEMBER_ID memberId , R.RESERVE_DATE reserveDate , R.RENTAL_START_DATE rentalStartDate , R.RENTAL_END_DATE rentalEndDate , R.APPROVE_STATUS approveStatus FROM TB_RESERVE R LEFT JOIN TB_MEMBER M ON R.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN TB_CAR C ON R.CAR_NO = C.CAR_NO ORDER BY R.RESERVE_DATE DESC

SELECT RESERVE_NO reserveNo , CAR_NO carNo , MEMBER_NO memberNo , STATUS status , RESERVE_DATE reserveDate , RENTAL_START_DATE rentalStartDate , RENTAL_END_DATE rentalEndDate , APPROVE_STATUS approveStatus FROM TB_RESERVE WHERE RESERVE_NO = #{reserveNo}
mapper.delete: UPDATE TB_RESERVE SET APPROVE_STATUS = 'N' WHERE RESERVE_NO = #{reserveNo}
